## 8. Q&A Section - Pre-populate Answers

Add these questions and answers to your GBP Q&A:

**Q: How many villas are available at The Pavillion?**  
A: The Pavillion has 33 standalone villas total. Please call +91 96760 77142 for current availability.

**Q: What is GP Development?**  
A: GP Development means you own the individual plot + villa with a direct sale deed. No shared ownership. We share all documents for independent legal verification before booking.

**Q: Are home loans available?**  
A: Yes. The Pavillion is pre-approved by SBI, ICICI, HDFC, Kotak, Bajaj Finance, and Karur Vysya Bank. Our team assists with loan documentation.

**Q: How far is it from Uppal Metro?**  
A: Just 8 minutes drive from Uppal Metro Station (Blue Line). Easy commute to Ameerpet, Secunderabad, HITEC City.

**Q: Can I customize my villa?**  
A: Yes! The Pavillion offers 'The Clean Slate' program - customize elevations, floor plans, and finishes before construction. In-house architects guide you.
